title: Completed realization identifies local completeness for the extended residue ideal
statement: For a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l, a Noetherian scheme X and any unbounded internal continuous integral coefficient complex K, let I be the kernel ideal of the reconstructed discrete first residue map [def-sfb-integral-models-stacks-data] and let IB be its extension along the reconstructed constant-to-continuous scalar map. The completed realization [def-sfb-integral-constant-model-realization] of K satisfies IsSfbAdicComplete [def-sfb-adic-stratified-perfect-data] if and only if the section-and-small-site realization of K is locally derived IB-complete [def-weil-pbc-locally-derived-ringed-ideal-complete]. No restriction functor or equivalence of derived complete subcategories is asserted.

source.place: Proof (1): flatness and quotient identification (Stacks 099L), and coefficient-presentation comparison

proof.text: The section-module scalar restriction comparison and the composition comparisons combine the four specified ordinary realization factors into restriction along completedSectionIso. Whisker with the small-site module transport.

Localize the ordinary comparison termwise. Factorization isomorphisms for the exact functors compare both chosen complex representatives with the same derived object. Local derived completeness is invariant under these isomorphisms because each defining internal Hom functor preserves isomorphisms.

Apply preservation and reflection of local derived ideal completeness under scalar restriction along the small-site coefficient isomorphism. Replace its extended first completed kernel by the discrete extended residue kernel using completedSectionIdeal. This proves the requested equivalence for every unbounded complex.

lean.statement:
theorem integralModels_complete_section_predicate (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X]
    (K : DerivedCategory (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1})
      (condensedRingObj (integersObj l E) X))) :
    let I := ConstantCompletion.kernelIdeal (smallMap X (residueMap l E X))
    let IB := I.extension (smallMap X (scalarMap l E X))
    Scheme.IsSfbAdicComplete X (IntegralConstantCompletion.ideal l E)
        ((IntegralConstantModel.derived l E X).functor.obj K) ↔
      IsLocallyDerivedRingedIdealComplete _ IB.module IB.inclusion
        (smallDerivedObject X _ K)
